heading: From brief to launched site in clear phases
subtext: Use this sequence to keep strategy, build, QA, and launch aligned.

items.title: Brand and conversion brief
items.description: Lock audience, offer hierarchy, and page goals before variant selection.

items.title: Compose page configs
items.description: Map hero/features/forms and pull assets from the design library.

items.title: Palette and typography tuning
items.description: Adjust theme on live builder and verify contrast and brand tone.

items.title: Validate and ship
items.description: Run config checks, build, and deploy with final metadata review.
